g.text: Option Desk - Historical backtest from prices to uncertainty
Record entry legs and capital at risk
Settle payoff at historical exit spot
Record return on risk when defined
Entry plus holding period fits history?
Summarize returns and drawdown in risk units
Block sign-flip randomization and moving-block bootstrap
Include buy-and-hold benchmark and model limitations
The pricing tenor uses trading days / 252.
Historical option quotes and execution are not replayed.
Two-expiry builders need inputs this runner does not supply.
Sign flips require a symmetry assumption.
One available bootstrap block gives no interval variation.
Sources: engine backtest/runner.py and stats.py; shell cli/backtest.py.
